items.prompt: Which order follows the allowed ASCII symbol keys ["A","0Z","AA","A0"]?

options.why: Digits come before uppercase letters, not after every letter key.
Digits precede letters, and a shorter equal prefix comes before its extensions.
A must precede its longer equal-prefix strings, and 0 precedes A after the shared prefix.
After prefix A, digit 0 sorts before letter A.

items.explanation: Digits precede letters, and a shorter equal prefix comes before its extensions.
